title: Holloman AFB Receives Next-Gen Fire Engine
description: Recently, Holloman Air Force Base received a new P-34 Rapid Intervention Vehicle that is part of a new class of fire fighting apparatus being rolled out Air Force-wide. The RIV costs three times less than a traditional fire engine or airfield crash truck, and is designed as a multipurpose vehicle, from the ground up.
keywords: Fire Department, Holloman AFB, P-34 Rapid Intervention Vehicle, new mexico
